task.title: Wire time-zone-settings HTTP and recomputation-coverage queries
task.input: analytics-settings-domain, analytics-aggregate-runtime and the existing ADMIN guard
task.accept: 1) Real HTTP GET returns current version/timezone/revision/recomputableFrom, and PATCH carries expectedVersion. An ADMIN change to a valid IANA time zone commits the new revision, pending recomputation and audit together; the next real job recomputes only complete coverage while older ranges retain original labels/partial (E-58). 2) Nonexistent IANA, stale version and direct SALES/EDITOR/unauthenticated requests are rejected with the original configuration entirely unchanged, without fallback to browser time zone (E-59). Existing about/org settings stay unchanged and responses pass section 10 schemas.
